title: Government's Obligation to Prescribe Persons for Consumer Mediation Cell

content.scenario: The Government of India wants to establish a consumer mediation cell to resolve consumer disputes. The Government must now decide who will be part of the cell.
content.outcome: The Government must prescribe the persons who will be part of the consumer mediation cell.

user_queries: Who will be part of the consumer mediation cell?
What is the Government's obligation regarding the consumer mediation cell?
Can the Government decide who will be part of the cell?
